description: This script automates the process of testing package dependencies within an OpenWrt build environment, handling setup, cleaning, and individual package tests with configurable options.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Runs the make command for a specific target package, logging output.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Cleans the kernel build directory except for the kernel source itself.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp file or symbolic link exists.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Verifies, builds, and logs the status of a specified package.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage help information for the script.
